#en: The AI Adapters allowed for not only more data to be pulled from the cores... But they also enabled a more creative application of that data!
zh: AI适配器不仅能从核心里提取更多数据……还能让这些数据得到更有创意的运用！

#en: Once you've cleared and captured a vessel, simply approach its main flight console and send a coded broadcast, flagging the ship for salvage.
zh: 一旦你清空并俘获一艘飞船，只要靠近它的主飞行控制台，发送一段编码广播，将该船标记为可拆解。

#en: Next thing I knew, I was on another ship. In all the chaos, Torin had somehow managed to get us off the Watchtower ship, and back aboard his.
zh: 等我回过神，我已在另一艘船上。一片混乱中，托林不知怎么把我们弄下了瞭望塔的船，回到了他自己的船上。

#en: We jumped to his location and engaged. He fought well, but by utilizing our Synapse Disruptor, eventually, we disabled both him and his ship.
zh: 我们跃迁到他的位置并交战。他打得很顽强，但靠突触干扰器，我们最终瘫痪了他和他的飞船。

#en: Sent your nav the coordinates. Huh, you know, this could be the very last Listening Post... Hm. I'll look into that. Let me know how it goes!
zh: 坐标已发到你导航。哦，你知道，这可能是最后一个监听哨了……嗯。我会查查。告诉我结果如何！

#en: But when it comes to multiverse jumping, eh, who knows?! Either way, some version of me should join you on any future jumps! Fingers crossed.
zh: 但说到多元宇宙跳跃，呃，谁知道呢？！不管怎样，以后每次跳跃应该都会有个版本的我陪你！祈祷吧。

#en: We'll do a quick scan of the planet, find the facility with the fleet Control Node, make our way inside, grab the loot, and get out of there!
zh: 我们快速扫描行星，找到有舰队控制节点的设施，进去，拿了东西，撤出来！

#en: Now, I'm a little sparse on the details, but I do know they call this weapon the "Synapse Disruptor". Which seems an apt name, if you ask me.
zh: 细节我知道的不多，但我知道他们管这武器叫「突触干扰器」。要我说，这名字挺贴切。

#en: Oh, bold! Usually I like that. But let's get one thing straight... If you want my assistance, you show me some courtesy, and I'll do the same.
zh: 哦，胆子不小！通常我喜欢这样。但先说清楚……你要我帮忙，就得对我客气点，我也会同样待你。

#en: And apparently, I've been roped into some sort of "project". Something about a "secretive organization", and data on a new type of technology?
zh: 而且看来我被拉进了某个「项目」。关于一个「神秘组织」，还有某种新科技的数据？

#en: We then brought Torin aboard. I didn't know what we planned to do with him, and frankly, I didn't ask. Watchtower doesn't encourage questions.
zh: 我们随后把托林带上了船。我不知道打算怎么处置他，说实话我也没问。瞭望塔不鼓励提问。

#en: If you're interested in manufacturing these parts, instead of finding them out on the field, I've prepared a slate detailing what you'll need.
zh: 你要是想自己制造这些部件，而不是在外面找，我准备了一块数据板，上面写着你需要什么。

#en: Sure thing. If we want a fleet, we need to ensure ship coordination, so we'll have to grab the Control Node, which we can find on Eridani III.
zh: 没问题。想要舰队，就得保证飞船协调，所以我们得拿到控制节点，它在波江座III上。

#en: Atmosphere seems breathable. Could risk going without a helmet, if you wanted. Besides that, abundant signs of life and a fairly high gravity.
zh: 大气似乎可以呼吸。你要是想冒险，不戴头盔也行。除此之外，生命迹象丰富，重力偏高。

#en: Haha! Eh, you're not wrong. I mean, the hours are bad, and the pay's even worse! Heh. Really, I suppose it's more of a "lifestyle" than a job.
zh: 哈哈！呃，你说得没错。工时糟，报酬更糟！嘿。说真的，与其说是工作，不如说是种「生活方式」。

#en: Let me... backtrack and rephrase things. There is no technological counter, to this weapon. No magic shields, or special kind of hull plating.
zh: 让我……退一步，换个说法。这种武器没有技术上的反制手段。没有什么魔法护盾，也没有特殊船壳板。

#en: You sure about that...? Tell you what, if we jump through The Unity again, next time, you try this by yourself. And let me know how that goes!
zh: 你确定……？这样吧，下次我们再穿过归一，你自己试试。然后告诉我结果如何！

#en: Newly commissioned vessels will automatically follow your lead ship. But if you'd prefer different tactics, you can always change their orders.
zh: 新订造的飞船会自动跟随你的领舰。但如果你想要不同战术，随时能更改它们的命令。

#en: Finished. With the Control Node installed into this mainframe, you can now direct a fleet of ships. You'll find it quite useful, and practical.
zh: 完成。控制节点已装入这台主机，你现在能指挥一支舰队。你会发现它既实用又方便。

#en: We should head over to Gren's workshop. Or, I suppose we could go to the bar, talk with Harper first. She did seem to want you for something...
zh: 我们该去格伦的工坊。或者，我想我们可以去酒吧，先跟哈珀谈谈。她似乎找你有事……

#en: Hm. It's thanks to her -- Stardock is even up and running in the first place! And I wasn't kidding about her being generous, she's good people.
zh: 嗯。全靠她——星坞才能运转起来！我说她慷慨可不是开玩笑，她是个好人。

#en: So, you're Torin's friend, right? If you've got some kinda grudge to settle with Watchtower, come talk with me. I think we can help each other.
zh: 那么，你是托林的朋友，对吧？你要是跟瞭望塔有什么过节，来找我谈。我觉得我们能互相帮忙。

#en: Life there isn't easy. Any air you breathe is heavily filtered, the lights are artificial, and you rarely see the sky. But for many, it's home.
zh: 那儿的生活不容易。呼吸的空气都经过重度过滤，灯光是人工的，几乎看不到天空。但对很多人来说，那里是家。

#en: Despite what we'd done to him, Torin still saved my life. I decided to desert Watchtower, help Torin instead. That's how I came to reside here.
zh: 尽管我们那样对他，托林还是救了我的命。我决定脱离瞭望塔，转而帮助托林。我就这样住到了这里。

#en: But I worked hard. And slowly, I improved. Eventually, I became one of the best independent technicians on Mars. Not that that's saying much...
zh: 但我很努力。慢慢地，我进步了。最终我成了火星上最好的独立技师之一。虽然这也没什么了不起……

#en: They worked as debt collectors for local dealers. I didn't like it, but survival doesn't give you much room for morals. I needed the credits...
zh: 他们给当地毒贩当讨债的。我不喜欢，但为了活下去没多少讲道德的余地。我需要钱……

#en: All these new stores, and people... I wasn't sure about it at first. But maybe it's not so bad. After all, people need reasons to stick around.
zh: 这么多新店、新面孔……我一开始还不确定。但也许没那么糟。毕竟，人需要有理由留下来。

#en: Now, we've got work to do. Gren and Harper are back on the station, let's head over and get you introduced. Remember, first impressions matter!
zh: 现在，我们有活要干。格伦和哈珀回站里了，我们过去给你做个介绍。记住，第一印象很重要！

#en: Before I met up with you, I ran into another Starborn. There was a fight. I won, but still. It shook me up a little! Like, what if I'd lost...?
zh: 在跟你碰头前，我遇到了另一个星裔。打了一场。我赢了，但还是，让我有点后怕！要是输了呢……？

#en: Here's how we're going to pull this fleet thing off. First, we need some hardware. Equipment -- especially designed to handle this sorta thing.
zh: 我们这样实现舰队这回事。首先，我们需要一些硬件。特别为应对这种事设计的装备。

#en: Hmm... I mean, I'm no expert, but it does seem like an incredibly sophisticated weapon! Definitely more powerful than a common-variety stunner.
zh: 嗯……我是说，我不是专家，但它确实像是极其精密的武器！肯定比常见的电击器强得多。

#en: Hmph. Anyway, despite your complete lack of a signal, I managed to intercept a Watchtower comm beacon and track you down the old-fashioned way.
zh: 哼。总之，尽管你完全没发信号，我还是截获了一个瞭望塔通讯信标，用老办法追踪到了你。

#en: Huh. That was almost coherent! You should be knee-deep in drool. Barely able to remember which shoe goes on which foot. I'm actually impressed!
zh: 哦。那几乎算条理清楚了！你本该口水满地、连哪只鞋穿哪只脚都记不清。我还真挺佩服！

#en: Next are Envoys. Foot soldiers, given simple tasks to keep operations running. They undergo minor genetic modification but still aren't trusted.
zh: 接下来是特使。普通兵员，执行维持行动运转的简单任务。他们接受轻度基因改造，但仍不被信任。

#en: I'm unsure. I always suspected that Watchtower's been around for a long time... I recall finding data records that were well over a century old.
zh: 我不确定。我一直怀疑瞭望塔存在很久了……我记得找到过一百多年前的数据记录。

#en: So, take these. That's all I have to hand right now. However, you can always craft additional flares. Assuming you have the necessary materials.
zh: 那么，拿着这些。我现在手头就这些。不过，你随时能制作更多信号弹。前提是你有必要的材料。

#en: I just so happen to know a few doctors. And at least one who has experience in cybernetics! Dr. Laine. So I asked if she'd mind joining us here!
zh: 我正好认识几个医生。至少有一个有赛博格方面的经验！莱恩医生。于是我问她愿不愿意来我们这儿！

#en: Not me, no. First, I asked Gren if he could build 'em, but he said something about him "being engineer, not a doctor.", which got me thinking...
zh: 我不行。起初我问格伦能不能造，但他说「自己是工程师，不是医生」，这让我动了念头……

#en: Here's the plan! We can draw power from the facility! You just need to flip some Breaker Switches. Should be four of them around the hangar bay.
zh: 计划是这样！我们可以从设施取电！你只要扳几个断路器开关。机库周围应该有四个。

#en: You know, personal choice. That kinda stuff. The paths and roads a person takes during their life. I guess people find it hard to be consistent?
zh: 你知道，个人选择。那类东西。一个人一生走的路。我猜人很难始终如一？

#en: Wasn't even sure if I was in the right universe or not. Maybe it's different for you, but for me, going through The Unity is super disorienting.
zh: 当时都不确定自己是不是到了对的宇宙。也许你不一样，但对我来说，穿过归一让人晕头转向。

#en: Well, no. Not technically. However, it's one thing to have other ships just follow you around, but we need more than that. We need coordination!
zh: 嗯，没有。严格说没有。不过，让别的船跟着你走是一回事，我们需要的不止这些。我们需要协调！

#en: But this brings me to why I made contact. I have devised a strategy that would keep you and me safe -- from Watchtower's impromptu abductions...
zh: 但这正是我联系你的原因。我设计了一套策略，能保你我的安全——免遭瞭望塔的临时绑架……

#en: I've made my notes on my terminal! Feel free to check them out for yourself. Might also help you keep tabs on the systems you've already cleared.
zh: 我把笔记记在终端上了！你随时可以自己看。也许还能帮你掌握已清理的星系。

#en: I had no idea having you and Torin around -- would bring so much attention to the station! Knowingly or not, you've brought a lot of people here.
zh: 我没想到有你和托林在——会给这空间站带来这么多关注！不管有意无意，你带来了很多人。

#en: Since it's you asking, I'll give it a try. I've still got a few contacts out in the field. Maybe one of them can help us find a Listening Post...
zh: 既然是你开口，我就试试。我在外面还有几个关系。也许其中一个能帮我们找到监听哨……

#en: Let's see... Only thing I've noticed so far is everyone's a bit more on edge in this universe. I think the chance for another war here is high...
zh: 让我想想……目前唯一注意到的是这个宇宙里大家都更紧张。我觉得这儿再打一场仗的可能性很高……

#en: And tell me, have you ever actually tried to coordinate multiple vessels, in the middle of battle, all at the same time? It's not easy, trust me.
zh: 告诉我，你真试过在战斗中同时协调多艘飞船吗？不容易，相信我。

#en: But the catch is, it's not something I can do alone, and it's gonna take effort. I'm gonna need your help on this, and you're going to need mine.
zh: 但问题在于，这事我一个人做不成，而且要花力气。我需要你帮忙，你也需要我。

#en: Right... I think Gren warned me about that. Most Watchtower stuff has a self-destruct of some kind. Stops people like me from getting too curious.
zh: 对……我想格伦警告过我。大多数瞭望塔的东西都有某种自毁。防止像我这样的人太好奇。

#en: And then we destroyed that Array -- a small fleet of Watchtower ships jumped in, attacking us on sight... I dunno, any of that sound like trouble?
zh: 然后我们摧毁了那个阵列——一小队瞭望塔飞船跃迁进来，一见面就攻击我们……我不知道，这些听着像麻烦吗？

#en: That's all we needed to do. Guess I'll be traveling with you for now. Hope you've room for a passenger! Alright, let's go get that Listening Post!
zh: 我们要做的就这些。看来我暂时要跟你同行了。希望你有地方带个乘客！好，我们去拿下那个监听哨！

#en: Can do! And once that's done, we'll be sure to put a permanent end to the Listening Post. Ensure there's no more sneaky spies in the neighborhood!
zh: 没问题！办完之后，我们肯定会把那监听哨彻底了结。确保附近再没有偷偷摸摸的探子！

#en: A lady knows better than to ask how and where you procure such things, but if you desire more these new Amps, simply bring me more Computer Cores.
zh: 淑女不会问你怎么弄到这些东西的，但你要是还想要这些新增幅，就再给我带些计算机核心来。

#en: Above them are Agents. Specialists in tech, surveillance, or networking. They handle the more complex tasks, and have a certain level of autonomy.
zh: 再往上是特工。技术、监视或人脉方面的专家。他们处理更复杂的任务，有一定自主权。

#en: And don't worry about the mech being flagged as contraband. Its armor will deflect most scanners. And if anyone asks? Well. It's just a big robot.
zh: 别担心机甲被标为违禁品。它的装甲能偏转大多数扫描。要是有人问？嗯，那就是个大家伙机器人。

#en: Gren has installed the Skydrop system on my ship, but we still only have a single missile. And we need that to crack open the Watchtower facility.
zh: 格伦在我的船上装了空投系统，但我们只有一枚导弹。而我们需要它来炸开瞭望塔的设施。

#en: When you have the time, I'd encourage you look into it. Who knows? Maybe it can provide answers to, both, your previous question and others too...
zh: 你有空的时候，我建议查一查。谁知道呢？也许它能回答你之前的问题，还有别的……

#en: You're still vulnerable to their Disruptor. They can easily disable and capture you whenever they like! Unless, we pursue this strategy of mine...
zh: 你仍然扛不住他们的干扰器。他们随时都能轻易瘫痪并抓走你！除非，我们采用我那个策略……

#en: Wow. Okay, that was fast. I barely searched for anything before it wiped itself... But I did at least pull the location for another Listening Post.
zh: 哇。好，真快。我还没搜什么它就自我清除了……但我至少挖出了另一处监听哨的位置。

#en: Detonates an electromagnetic pulse, disabling all electronic and robotic systems within range. Quite effective for neutralizing mechanical threats.
zh: 引爆一次电磁脉冲，瘫痪范围内所有电子和机器人系统。对压制机械威胁相当有效。

#en: I can't tell you what Watchtower's ultimate purpose is, but it seems clear to me that they do have one. And it involves people like you, and Torin.
zh: 我说不出瞭望塔的终极目的是什么，但在我看来他们确实有一个。而且牵涉到像你和托林这样的人。

#en: And you'd be able to salvage more components too! But how you go about it is down to you. You'll have to decide on a strategy you think works best.
zh: 你也能打捞到更多部件！但怎么做取决于你。你得决定自己认为最有效的策略。

#en: But, perhaps if you were to destroy some of less important "Minor Arrays" first, it would lessen Watchtower's reaction when you attack a Major one.
zh: 不过，也许你先摧毁一些不太重要的「小型阵列」，等你攻击大型阵列时，瞭望塔的反应会小一些。

#en: There were nights in Neon that I'd dream I could have somewhere like this. A place that people actually wanna be! Bit by bit, it's coming together.
zh: 在霓虹城有些夜里，我梦想能有这样一个地方。一个人们真正想去的地方！一点点地，它成形了。

#en: Although, no system is perfect. Skydrop has its drawbacks. First being, you need at least one manned ship in orbit with a Skydrop system installed.
zh: 不过，没有系统是完美的。空投也有缺点。首先，你需要至少一艘载人飞船在轨道上，并装有空投系统。

#en: It crippled your ship, right? Powered everything down. You were a sitting duck. Nothing you could do but wait for that next blast to knock you out.
zh: 它瘫痪了你的飞船，对吧？让一切断电。你成了活靶子。除了等下一发把你击倒，什么都做不了。

#en: Eh, it happens. Never witnessed it myself, though. Hm. We stumbled across an interesting catch, that's for sure! Might even bag us some promotions.
zh: 嗯，这常有。不过我自己没见过。嗯。我们确实逮到了一个有趣的猎物！说不定还能让我们升职。

#en: Let's see. There was a ground-based Listening Post with a bunch of troops. Then a space Array, with a Watchtower fleet that jumped in to protect it.
zh: 让我想想。地面上有个监听哨，一堆部队。然后太空里有个阵列，一支瞭望塔舰队跃迁进来保护它。

#en: ...You ever hear the expression "beggars can't be choosers"? *sigh* But, if you've got something in mind, suppose we can wait a little while longer.
zh: ……你听过「要饭的不能挑食」这说法吗？*叹气* 不过，你要是心里有数，我们大概还能再等等。

#en: Of course, things like Neuroamps have been available for some time. But when it comes to cybernetics, amps really are just the first stepping stone.
zh: 当然，像神经增幅器这样的东西已经有一阵子了。但说到赛博格化，增幅其实只是第一块垫脚石。

#en: The higher ranks include Officers, who are trusted to lead important operations. Watchmen, who perform independent missions with little oversight...
zh: 更高的军衔包括军官，被信任领导重要行动。还有巡守者，在少有监督下执行独立任务……

#en: Watchtower doesn't like their ships captured or salvaged. When badly damaged, they tend to self-destruct. Which is precisely what my old vessel did.
zh: 瞭望塔不喜欢自己的飞船被俘获或打捞。受重创时，它们往往自毁。我的旧船正是如此。

#en: The more time I spent with him, I realized, this guy, he actually seems to care about something bigger than himself. He's got a kinda drive, y'know?
zh: 跟他相处越久，我越发现，这家伙似乎真的在乎比自己更重要的东西。他有股劲头，你懂吗？

#en: Heh, I didn't even have any medical training. Mostly, I just joined to get out of Neon. But I didn't mind the work, and it felt good to help people.
zh: 嘿，我那时根本没什么医疗训练。主要是为了离开霓虹城才加入的。但我不讨厌这活，帮到人的感觉很好。

#en: We first met when Torin tried to take Stardock, not knowing I had already claimed it. There was a fight, but we quickly realized we weren't enemies.
zh: 我们初次见面时托林想夺取星坞，不知道我已经占了它。打了一架，但我们很快意识到彼此不是敌人。

#en: Hey, you think we should expand? You know, build more docking arms, maybe extra storage? I could easily afford it. Not as if we're shy on credits...
zh: 嘿，你觉得我们该扩建吗？你知道，多建几个对接臂，也许再加些仓储？我完全负担得起。反正我们也不缺钱……

#en: Of course, it'll cost you! These guys aren't going to help us out of the goodness of their hearts. But, if you're willing to cough up the credits...
zh: 当然，得花钱！这些人可不会出于好心帮我们。不过，你要是愿意掏钱……

#en: Hey, I've been thinking... This place wouldn't be what it is without you, so, I set up quarters for you here. Call it a "thank-you", from me to you.
zh: 嘿，我一直在想……没有你，这地方不会是现在这样，所以我在这儿给你安排了住处。就当是我对你说的一句「谢谢」。

#en: I'm done. The mainframe I just installed the Control Node into, will allow you to manage and command a fleet of ships. I think you'll find it useful.
zh: 完成了。我刚装入控制节点的主机，能让你管理和指挥一支舰队。我想你会发现它很有用。

#en: Obviously, I survived and didn't die horribly! Which is always nice. But my escape did put me a little farther away from you than I would've hoped...
zh: 显然，我活下来了，没惨死！这总是好事。但我脱身时离你比我预想的远了些……

#en: And that, of course, was Harper. Good job on your "first meeting" with her. I know this Unity stuff can be confusing, but so far, you're doing great!
zh: 那当然就是哈珀。你和她「初次见面」表现得不错。我知道归一这套东西容易让人糊涂，但到目前为止，你做得很好！

#en: The Arrays seem to be linked in a sorta... network. If a critical Major Array is attacked, you can expect a more aggressive response from Watchtower.
zh: 这些阵列似乎联成了一个……网络。如果关键的大型阵列被攻击，瞭望塔的反应会更激烈。

#en: Just another Neon street kid. Not worth their time. If it hadn't been for local medic taking pity and patching me up, I don't think I'd have made it.
zh: 不过是又一个霓虹城街头小孩。不值得他们花时间。要不是当地一个医护可怜我把我治好，我想我活不下来。

#en: I asked a contact of mine if she'd be willing to help out. She agreed! So you wannna see about neuroamps? Speak to Dr. Laine in the station's clinic.
zh: 我问了我一个关系愿不愿意帮忙。她答应了！所以你想弄神经增幅器？去空间站诊所找莱恩医生。

#en: Then, even if Watchtower track you down and get a shot in with their Disruptor, with other ships there to cover you -- they'd never get a second hit!
zh: 这样，就算瞭望塔找到你、用干扰器打中一发，有其他飞船掩护你——他们也别想打出第二发！

#en: And since they launched a Comm Beacon, I was able to intercept that. And then follow its trail back to where you were! Just in time to save your ass.
zh: 而且既然他们发射了通讯信标，我就能截获它。然后顺着线索找到你的位置！正好赶上救你的小命。

#en: Given how well they hide themselves, I think it stands to reason Watchtower has infiltrated the major governments. Maybe the larger corporations too.
zh: 既然他们藏得这么好，我觉得瞭望塔渗透了主要政府也说得通。也许大企业也是。

#en: Yeah, Gren warned me about that-- Ah! Sonofabitch! That was fast. Slate already wiped itself. But, I did grab a location for another Listening Post...
zh: 是啊，格伦警告过我——啊！狗娘养的！真快。数据板已经自我清除了。不过，我确实抢到了另一处监听哨的位置……

#en: There you are. Thanks to all the Watchtower components we've acquired, I've made several breakthroughs in bypassing certain ship hardware limitations.
zh: 你来了。多亏我们弄到的那些瞭望塔部件，我在绕过某些飞船硬件限制上取得了几个突破。

#en: Of course, I'll pass most of the credits on to you. Also, salvaging watchtower vessels -- may yield Computer Cores or other high-grade tech and parts.
zh: 当然，大部分钱我会转给你。另外，打捞瞭望塔飞船——可能会得到计算机核心或其他高级技术和部件。

#en: Torin seemed like a good man, he saved my life. And Watchtower had tried to imprison him. That didn't sit well with me. That's when I made up my mind.
zh: 托林看起来是个好人，他救了我的命。而瞭望塔想囚禁他。这让我很不舒服。我就是那时下定了决心。

#en: And lastly, Skydrop is a bulky system. Usually, you'd need a large ship to accommodate it. However, I've discovered some "workarounds" for that issue.
zh: 最后，空投是个笨重的系统。通常你需要一艘大船才能装下。不过，我发现了些解决这问题的「变通办法」。

#en: So, if you found yourself in some trouble, just hit some buttons on a flare, toss it down, and a few seconds later whatever you needed -- there it is!
zh: 所以，你要是遇上麻烦，只要在信号弹上按几个按钮，往下一扔，几秒后你需要的东西——就到了！

#en: Ships in orbit can fire down whatever was requested. Emergency backup, supplies, or sometimes just a good old airstrike! Or... "orbitstrike", I guess.
zh: 轨道上的飞船可以把你请求的东西打下来。紧急支援、补给，有时就是一次老式的空袭！或者……该叫「轨道袭」吧。

#en: Keep in mind -- at the moment, the Command System can only handle one additional ship. But if you want, you can always switch a vessel out for another.
zh: 记住——目前指挥系统只能支持一艘额外飞船。但你要是愿意，随时能把一艘换成另一艘。

#en: My genetic changes provide faster reflexes, improved spatial awareness, and better problem-solving. All designed to make me more effective in my field.
zh: 我的基因改造带来了更快的反射、更好的空间感知和更强的问题解决能力。全是为了让我在行当里更高效。

#en: As well as any of the less important Minor Arrays it was linked to self-destructing -- once the Major one has been destroyed, and they lose connection.
zh: 与它相连的那些不太重要的小型阵列也会自毁——一旦大型阵列被摧毁，它们失去连接。

#en: I went through bureaucratic hell. Weeks of red tape, forms, blank stares from officials who couldn't care less. Just to prove there was something here!
zh: 我经历了一场官僚地狱。数周的繁文缛节、表格，还有官员们漠不关心的茫然眼神。只为证明这里有东西！

#en: Yeah, actually. Stopped by the spot where I always find my ship, and it wasn't there! Spacers had taken it! *sigh* Don't worry though, I got it back...
zh: 是啊，确实。我去了平时找我飞船的地方，它不在！被太空客开走了！*叹气* 不过别担心，我拿回来了……

#en: Which means, we'll have a few more supplies to start with this time. And later on, if we want to, we may be able to build ourselves a new Perseverance.
zh: 这意味着这次我们起步时能有更多补给。以后，如果我们愿意，也许能给自己造一艘新的坚毅号。

#en: ...Blegh! That was a terrible answer, hah, probably made no sense! Um... Just know that Watchtower will lock you up, and throw away the figurative key.
zh: ……呃！这回答太糟了，哈，大概根本说不通！呃……你只要知道，瞭望塔会把你锁起来，然后扔掉那把象征性的钥匙。

#en: Listen, there'll be enemy reinforcements here at any moment, so I'm gonna use my ship to lure them away. Give them something else to chase for a while.
zh: 听着，敌方增援随时会到，所以我要用飞船把他们引开。给他们点别的东西追一阵。
